protocol_metadata.about: Fluid is a unified DeFi liquidity layer built by Instadapp (rebranded late 2024) that integrates lending, borrowing, and DEX functionality through a single shared Liquidity Layer contract. Users can lend assets to earn yield, borrow against collateral at high LTV ratios, or swap tokens through DEX pools that leverage Smart Collateral and Smart Debt — enabling collateral and borrowed positions to simultaneously earn LP fees. The DEX protocol does not accept direct LP deposits; liquidity is provided by depositing/borrowing from Vaults that use Smart Collateral or Smart Debt. Fluid is deployed on Ethereum (primary), Arbitrum, Base, and Polygon, with a Plasma chain deployment also referenced.
